description: For real x<y and a natural n with n(y−x)>1, the rational (floor(nx)+1)/n lies strictly between x and y.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.separating_rational (x y : ℝ) (hxy : x < y) (n : ℕ)
  (hn : 1 < ↑n * (y - x)) :
  have q := ↑(⌊↑n * x⌋ + 1) / ↑n;
  x < ↑q ∧ ↑q < y
